en.title: Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered Drops 2027 With Enhanced Graphics
en.summary: Agent 47's earliest missions are getting a significant glow-up. The original Hitman trilogy is being rebuilt with modern visuals and features, set to launch in 2027.
en.body:
The iconic **Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered** bundle has been officially announced, bringing the foundational stealth-action adventures of Agent 47 to modern platforms with a significant visual overhaul. This comprehensive collection includes the original three groundbreaking titles: **Hitman: Codename 47**, **Hitman 2: Silent Assassin**, and **Hitman: Contracts**. Developed by Saber Interactive in partnership with IO Interactive, the bundle promises to meticulously rebuild these beloved classics for a new generation of players.

Fans can expect upgraded character models, enhanced environments, and high-resolution textures, breathing new life into the gritty world of assassination. A key feature highlighted is the ability to toggle between the classic graphical presentation and the newly remastered visuals, allowing players to appreciate the evolution of the series. Furthermore, a photo mode is being integrated, offering new ways to capture iconic moments from Agent 47's early career. The announcement confirms that the trilogy will be available on PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5.

## A Return to the Roots

The original **Hitman** trilogy laid the groundwork for the stealth genre, establishing Agent 47 as one of gaming's most recognizable anti-heroes. **Hitman: Codename 47** introduced the world to the stoic, genetically engineered assassin. Its sequel, **Hitman 2: Silent Assassin**, expanded on the formula with more intricate levels and a compelling narrative that explored 47's personal connections. **Hitman: Contracts** delved into a darker, more psychological narrative, focusing on the internal struggles and iconic missions that shaped 47's legend. This remaster offers a chance to revisit these pivotal games with the polish they deserve, ensuring their legacy continues to resonate.

## What's Next for the Hitman Universe

While the **Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered** is a significant announcement, IO Interactive remains busy with its current **Hitman: World of Assassination** title. This week saw the release of the "World Champions" DLC, a World Cup-themed addition, and the popular rapper Wiz Khalifa is the latest Elusive Target, available until July 5th. Saber Interactive is also working on other ambitious projects, including **Jurassic Park: Survival**, **Stuntman: Hollywood**, and a new **John Wick** game, showcasing their versatility in the action and simulation genres. IO Interactive has also hinted at future installments in the **Hitman** series and is actively developing other major titles, including the **James Bond** game **007: First Light**.

The **Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered** is slated for release in 2027. Further details regarding specific release dates and any potential collector's editions have not yet been announced.

tr.title: Hitman Klasik Üçlü Remastered 2027'de Çıkmaya Hazırlanıyor
tr.summary: Agent 47'in en eski misyonları büyük bir ışıkla yeniden canlandırılıyor. Hitman klasik üçlü, modern görüntüler ve özellikleri ile 2027'de çıkacak.
tr.body:
Hitman Klasik Üçlü Remastered, Agent 47'in temel gizli-aksiyon maceralarını modern platformlara taşıyan ve önemli bir görsel yenilenme ile birlikte gelen ikonik bir pakettir. Bu kapsamlı koleksiyon, Agent 47'in ilk üç devasa oyununu içerir: Hitman: Codename 47, Hitman 2: Silent Assassin ve Hitman: Contracts. Saber Interactive ve IO Interactive'nin ortak girişimi ile geliştirilen paket, bu sevilen klasiklerin yeni bir nesle hizmet etmesi için dikkatlice yeniden inşa ediliyor.

Bu kapsamlı koleksiyon, oyuncuların 47'in erken kariyerindeki ikonik anları yeniden yaşamasına olanak tanıyan fotoğraf modu ile birlikte gelir. Oyuncular, klasik grafiksel sunumu ve yeni remastered görüntüleri arasında geçiş yapma seçeneğine sahiptir. Ayrıca, oyuncuların 47'in erken misyonlarını daha fazla ayrıntılı şekilde deneyimlemesine olanak tanıyan daha fazla ayrıntı da dahil olmak üzere, oyunun grafiksel sunumunda önemli gelişmeler de beklenmektedir.

Hitman Klasik Üçlü Remastered, PC, Xbox Series X|S ve PlayStation 5 için hazırlanmaktadır. Bu paket, Hitman serisinin gelecekteki oyuncularına Hitman serisinin temelini oluşturan bu oyunları yeniden keşfetme fırsatı sunacaktır.

## Hitman Serisinin Kökenleri

Hitman Klasik Üçlü, Hitman serisinin gelecekteki oyuncularına Hitman serisinin temelini oluşturan bu oyunları yeniden keşfetme fırsatı sunacaktır. Hitman: Codename 47, Agent 47'in dünya çapında tanınan bir suikastçı olarak tanıtılmasını sağlayan oyundur. Hitman 2: Silent Assassin, 47'in kişisel bağları ve daha karmaşık seviyeler ile daha derin bir hikaye sunan oyundur. Hitman: Contracts, 47'in iç savaşları ve ikonik misyonları ile daha psikolojik bir hikaye sunan oyundur.

## Hitman Serisinin Geleceği

Hitman Klasik Üçlü Remastered, Hitman serisinin gelecekteki oyuncularına Hitman serisinin temelini oluşturan bu oyunları yeniden keşfetme fırsatı sunacaktır. IO Interactive, Hitman: World of Assassination ile busyken, Saber Interactive de diğer önemli projeleri, Jurassic Park: Survival ve Stuntman: Hollywood ile geliştiriyor. IO Interactive, Hitman serisinin gelecekteki oyuncularına Hitman serisinin temelini oluşturan bu oyunları yeniden keşfetme fırsatı sunacaktır.

es.title: La Trilogía Clásica de Hitman se Remasteriza con Gráficos Mejorados en 2027
es.summary: El legado de Agente 47 se renueva con la llegada de la trilogía clásica remasterizada, que incluye los títulos originales con gráficos mejorados y características nuevas.
es.body:
La icónica colección **La Trilogía Clásica de Hitman Remasterizada** ha sido anunciada oficialmente, trayendo las aventuras de acción sigilosa fundacionales de Agente 47 a plataformas modernas con una renovada apariencia visual. Esta completa recopilación incluye los tres títulos originales innovadores: **Hitman: Codename 47**, **Hitman 2: Silent Assassin**, y **Hitman: Contracts**. Desarrollada por Saber Interactive en colaboración con IO Interactive, la colección promete reconstruir meticulosamente estos clásicos queridos para una nueva generación de jugadores.

Los fanáticos pueden esperar modelos de personajes actualizados, entornos mejorados y texturas de alta resolución, infundiendo nueva vida en el mundo sombrío de la asesinación. Una característica destacada es la capacidad de cambiar entre la presentación gráfica clásica y las nuevas visualizaciones remasterizadas, permitiendo a los jugadores apreciar la evolución de la serie. Además, se integra una función de modo de foto, ofreciendo nuevas formas de capturar momentos icónicos de la carrera temprana de Agente 47. El anuncio confirma que la trilogía estará disponible en PC, Xbox Series X|S, y PlayStation 5.

## Un Regreso a las Raíces

La trilogía original de **Hitman** sentó las bases para el género de sigilo, estableciendo a Agente 47 como uno de los anti-heroes más reconocibles del gaming. **Hitman: Codename 47** presentó al mundo al asesino genéticamente creado y silencioso. Su secuela, **Hitman 2: Silent Assassin**, amplió la fórmula con niveles más intrincados y una narrativa atractiva que exploró las conexiones personales de 47. **Hitman: Contracts** se adentró en una narrativa más oscura y psicológica, centrada en las luchas internas y misiones icónicas que moldearon la leyenda de 47. Esta remasterización ofrece la oportunidad de revisitar estos juegos pioneros con el brillo que merecen, asegurando que su legado continúe resonando.

## Próximos Pasos para el Universo de Hitman

Si bien la **La Trilogía Clásica de Hitman Remasterizada** es un anuncio significativo, IO Interactive sigue ocupada con su título actual de **Hitman: World of Assassination**. Esta semana vio el lanzamiento del DLC "World Champions", una adición basada en la Copa del Mundo, y el rapero popular Wiz Khalifa es el último objetivo elusivo, disponible hasta el 5 de julio. Saber Interactive también está trabajando en otros proyectos ambiciosos, incluyendo **Jurassic Park: Survival**, **Stuntman: Hollywood**, y un nuevo juego de **John Wick**, demostrando su versatilidad en los géneros de acción y simulación. IO Interactive también ha insinuado futuras entregas en la serie de **Hitman** y está desarrollando otros títulos importantes, incluyendo el juego de **James Bond** **007: First Light**.

La **La Trilogía Clásica de Hitman Remasterizada** está programada para su lanzamiento en 2027. Se han anunciado detalles específicos sobre fechas de lanzamiento y posibles ediciones coleccionables.

content_raw: While fans await the next mainline Hitman game, IO Interactive and Saber Interactive have announced that the original three games in the series are being remastered in a bundle called the Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered. Specifically, Hitman: Codename 47, Hitman 2: Silent Assassin, and Hitman: Contracts are included in the bundle. The game's have been "painstakingly rebuilt," according to the official announcement. The new versions of the original games include "upgraded character models, enhanced environments, and high-resolution textures." The remaster bundle also includes the ability to toggle between classic and updated graphics and a photo mode. An example of the improved graphics. The Hitman Classic Trilogy Remastered bundle releases in 2027. It's coming to PC, Xbox Series X|S, and PlayStation 5. It's just the latest project from Saber, as the company is also working on Jurassic Park: Survival, Stuntman: Hollywood, and a new John Wick game. IO Interactive's latest release, meanwhile, was the popular James Bond game 007: First Light. The studio is eyeing multiple sequels , and has also pledged to return to Hitman someday . In other Hitman news, IO Interactive announced at Summer Game Fest that the latest Elusive Target for Hitman: World of Assassination is the rapper Wiz Khalifa. The mission is available now through July 5. Additionally, World of Assassination got a new update this week that added the "World Champions" DLC, which is themed around the World Cup.
